source.caption: Visualization of microbial community distributions using PCA (left) and t-SNE (right). Each data point represents a microbial sample, colored by location. PCA captures variance linearly, while t-SNE reveals non-linear relationships. In the case of t-SNE, distinct dispersal patterns are observed across locations. STR, MI, GLRC, and SUP correspond to the Mackinaw Straits, Lake Michigan, the Great Lakes Research Center at Michigan Tech, and Lake Superior, respectively.
